maria_cs: Tektide pinged — new expansion signal. Two new teams (Product Analytics + Docs) started onboarding yesterday. They've ramped embeddings + summarization usage; QPS jumped ~3x in 24h. They asked about dedicated capacity and faster ingest. Ticket: https://redwood.app/tickets/TEK-4567 :eyes:
ops_bot: alert — tektide-prod org usage at 72% of quota, embeddings requests spiking. Top route: /v1/embeddings. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/in/orgs/tektide/usage
rahul_csm: Good catch. Any legal/PII flags from the Docs team? We'll need to know for Private/Dedicated ask.
maria_cs: Docs team uses internal HR PDFs, some PII. Customer asked about VPC/private deployment as possibility. Product Analytics is ok with hosted but want SLA.
jordan_se: For short term we can offer a Dedicated pilot: 2 pods (A100x2) w/ prefix caching and batching tuned. Rough quote: $Xk/mo. I'll draft config.
amy_success: I'll book enablement session & ingestion runbook. Proposed: Tue 10am PT onboarding workshop + tokenization best practices. @sophie_sales can you confirm AM availability?
sophie_sales: Confirmed — AM can join. Also FYI renewal due in 11 months; expansion positive for renewal but could flip if latency/regressions happen now.
rahul_csm: Let's capture requirement matrix: latency < 200ms p95 for embeddings, ingestion throughput 5000 docs/hr. Also list compliance guardrails. I'll update the ticket.
maria_cs: Added notes to TEK-4567 and flagged as 'expansion-opportunity / renewal-watch'. Assigning follow-ups: Jordan (config), Amy (enablement), Rahul (security), Sophie (sales).
amy_success: Quick checklist for the workshop:
```
- sample data ingest
- mapping embeddings -> namespace
- setup prefix cache
- monitor dashboards
```
Will share invite + calendar.
jordan_se: If they want quicker rollout, we can enable KV cache retention and prewarm KV for hot docs. Recommend canary with 10% traffic.
maria_cs: Great. I'll reach out to customer success lead to propose pilot plan and push timeline. Thanks team :thumbsup:
